claim: Venice Carnival 2025 drew about 1 million visitors to the historic centre over its run, not the ~3 million cited by some aggregators; the final weekend alone reached nearly 330,000 (86k Fri, 130k Sat, 110k Sun).
quote: in questo ultimo fine settimana di festa la città ha retto quasi 330mila presenze. E complessivamente sono un milione le persone che sono giunte in centro storico dal 14 febbraio giorno di avvio del Carnevale.

claim: Venice Carnival is concentrated in three weekends, with hotel occupancy of 80-95% on weekends versus 60-65% on weekdays, and no sell-out in 2025.
quote: i fine settimana caratterizzati da un'alta occupazione, tra l'80 e il 95%, mentre nei giorni feriali l'afflusso è stato inferiore, con percentuali che oscillavano tra il 60 e il 65%

claim: Nuit Blanche 2026 was the 25th edition, themed around love, featuring nearly 200 free installations, held the night of 6-7 June 2026 under artistic director Barbara Butch.
quote: The 25th annual Nuit Blanche (White Night) contemporary art festival will transform Paris into a giant artistic playground on Saturday. ... she has responded to the hate with love – in all its forms. ... nearly 200 free installations focused on love, celebration and collective creativity.

claim: La Mercè closes with the Piromusical at the Font Màgica de Montjuïc; the 2025 finale drew more than 110,000 spectators, the show returning after years disrupted by the fountain's restoration works.
quote: Barcelona despidió este domingo, 28 de septiembre, sus fiestas de La Mercè 2025 con un espectáculo que congregó a más de 110.000 asistentes frente a la Font Màgica de Montjuïc. ... El tradicional piromusical volvió a iluminar la capital catalana tras varios años condicionado por las obras de restauración de la fuente
